title: Fuel Tank Capacity Reference — 2.3L EcoBoost
introduction:
I choose the engine-specific row before reading a tank capacity. This sheet belongs to the EcoBoost fuel-tank section and also includes explicitly labeled comparison entries for other engines. Keep those labels attached to their figures; tank capacities are not a family-size serving suggestion.

The table presents capacity in gal with L alongside. It describes tank size, not the amount currently present or proof that fuel delivery is healthy. It provides no fuel-pressure test or tank-service procedure.

edits.why: Match the engine to its labeled capacity row and keep each gal value paired with its printed L equivalent. The unqualified Fuel Tank Capacity row has no value to use. The comparison entries do not broaden this section's service-procedure applicability, and capacity alone cannot establish fuel pressure or delivery performance.
